myTables.title: My tables as a master
myTables.emptyTitle: You have not created any table yet
myTables.emptyDescription: Once you create a table, you will see it here.

create.title: Create a table
create.description: Four steps. The table stays in preparation until an admin reviews it.
create.reviewNotice: An admin will review the table before it opens to applications.
create.permittedLabel: What is allowed at the table
create.permittedHint: The house rules: what material is in, what tone the table has, what is out.
create.startDateHint: In your own time. It is stored in UTC.
create.durationHint: Of one session, not of the campaign.

status.waitingForAdmin: Waiting for an admin to review it.
status.pausedByAdmin: The table has been paused by an admin.
status.resubmitConfirmDescription: It goes back to preparation, waiting for an admin to review it.
status.startConfirmDescription: The table moves to in progress.
status.cancelDialogDescription: Say why it is being cancelled — it goes on the record.
status.deleteConfirmDescription: Nobody has seen it yet, so it is removed without a public trace. This cannot be undone. If it had already opened, the right thing is to cancel it.

schedule.timeZoneHint: Times are typed in your zone ({{timeZone}}) and stored in UTC.

sessions.emptyDescription: They are created on their own when an admin approves the table, out of the start date, the weekly agenda and the number of sessions. If any of the three is missing, the table opens without a calendar and it appears as soon as you fill it in.
sessions.pausedDescription: While it is paused no dates are promised: the pending sessions are hidden and get re-scheduled from the day it resumes.
sessions.notesPlaceholder: What happened, what is still open…
sessions.notesArePrivate: The notes are yours: no player sees them.
sessions.holdConfirmDescription: It goes on the record as played and its date can no longer be corrected. Recording attendance is a separate action.
sessions.cancelConfirmDescription: The session goes on the record as cancelled and the table adds another one at the end of the calendar, so it still plays the same number. The players are notified.
sessions.cancelSuccess: Session cancelled; one was added at the end

locked.Held: It was played: the date and the notes are a record now and are not edited.
locked.Cancelled: It is cancelled: it stayed as a record and is not edited.

sessions.attendanceNotForCancelled: A cancelled session has no attendance: it did not happen.
